text:
No option can be put forward yet, because the model could not test your requirement that monthly churn remain **<4% per month**.

- The price scenarios were compared with moderate robustness, but that result excludes the churn constraint entirely.
- The comparison also rests partly on Olumi-authored assumptions; notably, Non‑Pro MRR was defaulted to **£0 per month**, not supplied by you.
- Active Pro subscribers are the model’s most structurally influential factor; its evidence source is not recorded.
